title: Nintendo Switch 2 Black Friday deals 2026 UK: console and bundle prices
seoTitle: Switch 2 Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Live Bundle Deals
description: Nintendo Switch 2 Black Friday 2026: today's UK console and bundle prices, the £354.99 low to aim for, and which bundle is the best value.
intro:
**Short answer: the best Switch 2 deal right now is the Switch 2 + Switch Sports Resort bundle at £399 at Amazon, £40 off and £20 less than the console's £419.99 RRP on its own.** If you'd rather have a game you can lend, Very has the Sports Resort bundle with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for £449.99 (was £509.98).

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November and Black Friday itself is on 27 November. The new Mario Kart World bundle is still full price at £459.99 on Nintendo's UK store, so it isn't the one to buy this week. Prices last checked on Saturday 21 November 2026. For more gaming and tech, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

body:
## Switch 2 prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the lowest UK prices we've seen. At or near these, it's a genuinely good deal.

- **Switch 2 console (RRP £419.99):** £354.99 at Amazon during Prime Big Deal Days, 6–7 October 2026, matched by Argos, John Lewis and Smyths. Which? puts the six-month average at about £420. Anything under £370 is good.
- **Mario Kart World bundle (2026 edition, RRP £459.99):** the old version was about £415 at Amazon in October. Aim for £420 or less.
- **Black Friday 2025, for reference:** the original Mario Kart World bundle (RRP £429.99, with a physical game) fell to £404.95 at Amazon and £409 at Currys, John Lewis and Very.

## Which Switch 2 should you buy?

**Console only:** best if you already know which games you want, or want to buy games second-hand.

**A bundle with a game you'd buy anyway:** the cheapest way in this week. The Sports Resort bundle at £399 at Amazon costs less than the console's RRP on its own.

**The 2026 Mario Kart World and Sports Resort bundles:** fine for Christmas, but note the game is a digital code linked to your Nintendo account, not a cartridge you can lend or sell. They also include 90 days of Nintendo Switch Online. The Sports Resort bundle is £399 at Amazon; the Mario Kart one is still £459.99 at Nintendo's store.

**Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition:** a special-design console with no game. Only for collectors.

## Will the Switch 2 be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Probably a little. Retailers have already shown they'll sell the console for £354.99, and Black Friday prices usually match or beat Prime sale prices. But the price rise in September came from rising memory costs, and stock of the cheapest bundles is thinning, so a drop well below £355 seems unlikely. Our steer: if you see the console at about £355, or a game bundle at £400 or less, buy it. The £399 Amazon Sports Resort bundle meets that bar.

### Is it worth buying a Switch 2 now or waiting?

If a bundle suits you, buy now: the Sports Resort bundle at £399 is under the console's RRP. If you only want the console, it was £354.99 in early October, so it's worth waiting to see whether Black Friday matches that.

### Which Switch 2 bundle is the best value?

The Sports Resort bundle at £399 at Amazon, by a distance. The Mario Kart World bundle is still at its £459.99 RRP, and Very's two-game bundle is £449.99.

### Does the Mario Kart World bundle come with a physical game?

Not the 2026 version. It comes with a download code. Last year's bundle had a cartridge; if you see one of those still on sale, check the listing carefully.

### Where is cheapest for the Switch 2 in the UK?

It changes week to week. This week Amazon has the cheapest bundle we can confirm (£399). Amazon, Argos, John Lewis and Smyths all matched the £354.99 low in October, so check them all on Black Friday. Currys' Black Friday sale is already running, so keep an eye on it too.

See also our [Black Friday 2026 guides](/black-friday/), including [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), and [what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/).
